componentLib.name: Scalable UI Architecture
componentLib.description: Decoupled component library designed for high-traffic B2C platforms. Built with strict performance guidelines.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: Hello! I'm Juan Carlos, a Software Engineer with over 5 years of experience specializing in the modern Angular ecosystem and TypeScript.
about.p2: My journey has led me to work on high-traffic B2C platforms and global e-commerce systems, where I focus on performance optimization, decoupled component architectures, and delivering exceptional user experiences.
about.p3: When I'm not architecting web platforms, I'm usually exploring game development mechanics (Unreal Engine) or enjoying tactical RPGs.
